name: glm53f
title: GLM 5.3 Flash - EXL3 streaming runner
summary: GLM-5.3-Flash's runner for the turboexl3 EXL3 streaming repacks, with mlx-serve #1196's speed changes, over the kit's KDA-hybrid trunk; the pack's EXL3 linears and routed bank stay the turboexl3_glm53f quant plugin's. M5-class Macs (NAX).
models: glm5_next with an exllamav3 quantization_config and a turboexl3 expert_streaming bank (OpensourceWTF/GLM-5.3-Flash-streaming-repack-exl3: sc_2.10bpw, sc_2.60bpw, sc_3.10bpw, sc_4.10bpw), beside turboexl3_glm53f
kit_note: Needs a kit with the KDA-hybrid base (kit.bases.kda_hybrid with Hooks.router and KdaConsts.stages), kit.mlx_device and Host.quant_claimant: mlx-serve's J1, E4, J5c, J6 and J4 (built here against glm-cs/s1-base2).
